**Finding: compliant (preferred level) — no redline proposed.**

§ 22 (Audit Rights) meets every element of the preferred AUDIT position:

| Preferred element | Where met |
|---|---|
| Once per 12 months | 22.1 "no more than once in any twelve-month period" |
| 30 days' written notice | 22.1 "at least thirty days' prior written notice" |
| Business hours | 22.1 "during normal business hours" |
| Independent auditor | 22.1 "by an independent auditor" |
| Auditor bound by confidentiality | 22.1 "bound by confidentiality" |
| Off-site where possible | 22.1 "off-site where practicable" |
| Vendor cost unless underpayment > 5% | 22.2 "unless the audit establishes an underpayment exceeding five percent" |
| No direct system access | 22.2 "may not access Customer systems directly" |

§ 23 (Records and Customer Assurance) is a bare heading with no operative text, so it creates no parallel audit or records-inspection burden, and no other verification right binding us appears elsewhere in the agreement. The extras in 22.2–22.3 (no access to unrelated Customer Data, privileged material or other suppliers' confidential information; findings are our Confidential Information usable only to enforce the Agreement; shortfall payment closes the issue absent fraud) favour us and are left untouched.
